name: Pórtugos (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and green with a broad white middle stripe, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Pórtugos (a mountain and a fountain on green) above five orange roundels.
history: Municipal flag of Pórtugos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: five roundels in a row beneath the arms
